title: The phone shell
steps: On a phone (or with ?device=phone at the end of the address on a laptop): the bottom bar says Feed, Today, Calendar, Search and Places. Tap Feed: your notes, until the Feed exists. Tap one: it opens full screen. Swipe back, or tap ‹: the list again.
Tap Places: Feed, Today, Tasks, Calendar, Contacts, Sources, Uploads, Extensions, Settings. Customize the bottom bar…: swap Calendar for Tasks.
In a note, tap the clock-with-arrow: its History, in a sheet; drag it down to close. Tap ⋯: Open note in a new tab is greyed, needing a screen 600px wide.
Tap into a list item: the keyboard toolbar takes the bottom bar's place. Make a task, add a due date, indent and outdent with its buttons; the crossed-out keyboard stops editing.
Add it to your phone's home screen: it opens on its own, without the browser's bars.
